description: This file declares the QpackDecoder class and related interfaces for decoding QPACK headers in a QUIC connection, including error handling, stream management, and dynamic table operations.

classes.name: QpackDecoder
classes.description: Main class for decoding QPACK headers, managing header streams, dynamic table, and error signaling.

classes.name: QpackDecoder::EncoderStreamErrorDelegate
classes.description: Interface for handling encoder stream errors.

methods.name: QpackDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with capacity limits and error delegate.

methods.name: OnStreamReset
methods.description: Notify decoder that a stream has been reset, affecting header block processing and eviction.

methods.name: OnDecodingCompleted
methods.description: Notify that decoding of a stream has completed.

methods.name: CreateProgressiveDecoder
methods.description: Create a decoder for a header block with a specified handler.

methods.name: OnDuplicate
methods.description: Handle duplication of header table entry.

methods.name: OnSetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Set new capacity for dynamic table.

methods.name: OnErrorDetected
methods.description: Handle an error detected on the stream.

methods.name: set_qpack_stream_sender_delegate
methods.description: Set delegate for Qpack stream sender.

methods.name: dynamic_table_entry_referenced
methods.description: Check if any dynamic table entries are referenced.
